Name: DaVinci Resolve
Description: Dial controls for DaVinci Resolve color tools and timeline

Actions.Name: Color Wheel Adjust
Actions.Tooltip: Point at color wheels, sliders, curves, or numeric fields, then turn the dial to adjust.

Actions.Name: Timeline Control
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to control the timeline. Press and turn to select one of six modes.

Localization.DaVinci Resolve not detected. Open DaVin: DaVinci Resolve not detected. Open DaVinci Resolve, then this plugin will reconnect automatically.
Localization.DaVinci Resolve detected. Switch to the: DaVinci Resolve detected. Switch to the Color page and open Color Wheels.
Localization.DaVinci Resolve is not ready yet. Open D: DaVinci Resolve is not ready yet. Open DaVinci Resolve and keep the Color page visible.
Localization.DaVinci detection unavailable. Please ch: DaVinci detection unavailable. Please check plugin dependencies.
Localization.Plugin connection lost. DaVinci status c: Plugin connection lost. DaVinci status cannot be checked.
Press and turn the dial to switch modes. For zoom, track height, or scrolling, keep the pointer over the timeline.
Localization.Timeline backend will be selected automa: Timeline backend will be selected automatically.
Localization.Click Resolve once to bring it to the fo: Click Resolve once to bring it to the foreground. Press and turn the dial to choose a mode, then release to confirm. For zoom, track height, and scrolling, keep the pointer over the timeline area.
